title: Trace
description: Reachability verdict for a single canonical finding.

reachable.description: True iff attacker-controlled input from an external entry point can reach the sink.

entry_points.description: External entry points from which the sink is reachable. Empty if reachable=false.

call_chain.description: Ordered chain from entry to sink. First element is the entry frame; last is the sink.

external_inputs.description: Specific input parameters that flow into the sink.

blockers.description: Reasons the path is NOT reachable (sanitizers, auth gates, dead code, etc.).

exploitability.description: Static exploitability analysis, produced when reachable=true (ported from ai-proofscan's static exploitability analysis). Advisory only — never overrides the finding's CVSS-derived severity (V4), which remains authoritative.

needs_poc.description: True when static reasoning alone cannot settle exploitability (e.g. depends on runtime config/state); false when source reading alone settles it.

attack_input.description: Concrete attacker-controlled value/payload that would trigger the sink (a static sketch, NOT executed).

narrative.description: Short exploitability narrative grounded in file:line evidence.
